raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`collect_path_info` hands a caller the root-to-node chain for each requested end node as `TreePathNodeInfo` records (node id, parent id, path span, FULL value length). A caller that reads tree paths by node id, for example a background writer that must decide whether a node is a branch point or the middle of a straight chain before publishing it, had no way to tell the two apart from the record and needed a second trip into the tree.

## Modifications

- `TreePathNodeInfo` gains `num_children`, the node's immediate child count at the time of the snapshot, in the Rust core (`unified_tree_core.rs`), the Python reference core (`unified_tree_core.py` / `unified_tree_core_interface.py`) and the bindings tuple (`python_bindings.rs`). The Python adapter already builds the record positionally from the tuple, so it picks the field up unchanged.
- Like the rest of the record it is a snapshot: a later split or eviction changes the tree, not a record already handed out.
- Rust unit test `assert_path_info`: build the two-node path with a split so the head node has a real child, add a second branch and check both chains report the branch point, then evict the branch and check the earlier snapshot was not mutated.
- Python integration test: check the new field through the bindings on both backends, including after a split that turns a chain node into a branch point.

## Accuracy Tests

No model behaviour changes; this adds a read-only field to a tree inspection record.

## Benchmarking and Profiling

Not applicable: one extra `usize` per path record on an inspection path.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Code Formatting with Pre-Commit](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-formatting-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests as outlined in the [Running Unit Tests](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#running-unit-tests-adding-to-ci).
- [x] Update documentation / docstrings / example tutorials as needed, according to [Writing Documentation](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#writing-documentation-running-docs-ci).
- [x] Provide throughput / latency benchmark results and accuracy evaluation results as needed, according to [Benchmark and Profiling](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/benchmark_and_profiling.html) and [Accuracy Results](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy).
- [x] For reviewers: If you haven't made any contributions to this PR and are only assisting with merging the main branch, please remove yourself as a co-author when merging.
- [x] Please feel free to join our Slack channel at https://slack.sglang.ai to discuss your PR.

@@ -116,6 +116,7 @@ class TreePathNodeInfo(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):
     path_end: int
     # Logical FULL device indices; None when the value is absent.
     full_value_len: Optional[int]
+    num_children: int
 
 
 class InsertStepResult(msgspec.Struct, frozen=True):

@@ -1054,23 +1054,32 @@ def insert(tokens, namespace):
     other = insert(tokens, "second")
     before = core.collect_path_info((other, root, leaf, other))
     assert before == (
-        (TreePathNodeInfo(other, root, 0, length, length),),
+        (TreePathNodeInfo(other, root, 0, length, length, 0),),
         (),
-        (TreePathNodeInfo(leaf, root, 0, length, length),),
-        (TreePathNodeInfo(other, root, 0, length, length),),
+        (TreePathNodeInfo(leaf, root, 0, length, length, 0),),
+        (TreePathNodeInfo(other, root, 0, length, length, 0),),
     )
     with pytest.raises(AttributeError):
         before[0][0].path_end = 99
 
+    core.match_prefix(
+        MatchPrefixParams(
+            key=RadixKey(array("q", tokens[:3]), extra_key="first", is_bigram=is_eagle)
+        )
+    )
+    chain = core.collect_path_info([leaf])[0]
+    assert [node.num_children for node in chain] == [1, 0]
+
     insert([1, 2, 3, 7, 8, 9], "first")
     path = core.collect_path_info([leaf])[0]
     split = 3 - int(is_eagle)
     assert len(path) == 2
-    assert path[0] == TreePathNodeInfo(path[0].node_id, root, 0, split, split)
+    assert path[0] == TreePathNodeInfo(path[0].node_id, root, 0, split, split, 2)
     assert path[1] == TreePathNodeInfo(
-        leaf, path[0].node_id, split, length, length - split
+        leaf, path[0].node_id, split, length, length - split, 0
     )
-    assert before[2] == (TreePathNodeInfo(leaf, root, 0, length, length),)
+    assert [node.num_children for node in chain] == [1, 0]
+    assert before[2] == (TreePathNodeInfo(leaf, root, 0, length, length, 0),)
     core.reset()
     with pytest.raises(KeyError):
         core.collect_path_info([leaf])
@@ -1091,7 +1100,7 @@ def test_host_only_and_root_adjustments_are_noops(backend, is_eagle):
         root, key, torch.arange(100, 100 + len(key)), ["hash"] * len(key)
     ).inserted_host_node
     assert core.collect_path_info([host]) == (
-        (TreePathNodeInfo(host, root, 0, len(key), None),),
+        (TreePathNodeInfo(host, root, 0, len(key), None, 0),),
     )
